"Oh, there there. My poor, cute kitty. I'll avenge you.
"Insolent fiend! Step away from the Princess at once!
"Heh heh heh... You can't lure my Jade into your party.
"With my power I made Jade a lovely monster and my faithful servant.
"Humans into monsters...? Then the other monsters, too, besides Jade...?
"Not just Jade. All the monster staff at this casino were once human.
"Turning humans who won big and got cocky into monsters and working them hard is my greatest joy!
"Jade is our dear companion. We won't let her join your evil deeds! Give Jade back!
"Whoever wrecks my paradise gets a hundred whacks! Vanish, all of you!!"
